# The White Witch™

> Three doors lead: The White Witch, Mira's World, and Emoji Games. LibreSky is second, in two editions. The public client opens in the browser. LibreSky Corporate is the one you host. Blogy, MAGIC Dock, Cinder, and Vesper are native Qt. MAGIC Dock runs on Linux. Mail: thewhitewitchtm@google.com.

No accounts on this site. The work is linked below.

## Doors

- [The White Witch](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/whitewitch/): politics, tools, and the long pages. Facts first.
- [Mira's World](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/mira/): tools, projects, tutorials, and the dev blog.
- [Emoji Games](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/emojigames/)

## LibreSky

- [LibreSky](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/LibreSky/): Bluesky client in the browser. Edit, AI, voice, video, and chat. Opens directly.
- [LibreSky source](https://github.com/TheWhiteWitchTM/LibreSky)
- [LibreSky Corporate](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/corporate/): the edition you host. Small enough for a Pi. Coming soon.

## Native Qt

- [Blogy](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/blogy/): Markdown editor. Preview, front matter, publish with git.
- [MAGIC Dock](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/magic-dock/): a dock for Pop!_OS COSMIC. Linux only. Stacks.
- [Cinder](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/cinder/): an editor for bash and sh.
- [Vesper](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/vesper/): music and video for the quiet hours.
- [RETRO Center](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/retro-center/): a shelf for the C64, the Apple II, the TI-99/4A, the Amiga, and the Atari ST.

## Also

- [MAGIC](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/magic/): Lua and BASIC, compiled to JavaScript. Studio, Apprentice, and RETRO MAGIC are linked from that page.
- [FAUX NEWS](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/faux-news/): satire. The right-wing wires, with a joke filed beside the headline they ran. The desk itself is [here](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/FauxNews-/).
